question.text: Support level in technical analysis refers to:

answer.text: A ceiling the price struggles to breach
A price zone with strong buying interest that tends to stop price declines
A price level targeted by sellers

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 53 identifies support as the level with buying interest where price declines tend to halt. The Trap: Resistance is the selling-interest level; the other options do not match the technical-analysis definition. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A page 53.
